card.name: Reasons given after because/due to
card.fires_on: Words inside a reason clause explaining why drugs differ or are not interchangeable, such as 'the' after 'because' or 'to' after 'due'. Also nouns like labeling, administration or levels in such clauses.

modes.label: Because-clause openers
modes.description: A 'the' or 'to' right after 'because' or 'due' that starts the stated reason for a difference between products.
modes.example: without supervision of a physician with experience in immunosuppressive therapy because<< the>> rates of absorption following the administration of CELL

modes.label: Nouns of difference
modes.description: Nouns in the reason that name what differs between products, such as labeling, routes of administration or plasma levels.
modes.example: they have different recommended dosages and routes of<< administration>>. Patients receiving intravenous pembroliz
